related_questions.question: What is the outline of type 1 diabetes?
related_questions.snippet: Type 1 diabetes is a condition where your body cannot make a hormone called insulin. Insulin helps your body use glucose (sugar) for energy. Without insulin the level of glucose in your blood becomes too high. If you have type 1 diabetes, you'll need to take insulin every day to manage your blood glucose levels.
